card.name: Just before the word face
card.fires_on: Words right before 'face', 'facial' or a facial expression is named, such as a smile, look or relief 'on his face', or a list of face parts. Also weakly on odd spots in facial-injection label text.

modes.label: Expression before 'on his face'
modes.description: An emotion word or look is followed by 'on his face' in a description of a person.
modes.example: a proud, boyish<< smile>> on his face.

modes.label: Face parts and descriptions
modes.description: Lists of face areas or portrait-like descriptions lead into the word face or facial.
modes.example: cover the face (i.e., forehead, cheeks, nose,<< and>> chin).

modes.label: Facial injection labels
modes.description: Spots in botulinum toxin label text about facial muscles and injection sites.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for faces and facial expressions, mostly in Chinese and English.
